items.title: Love in Disguise
items.overview: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

items.title: Make Me Tingle
items.overview: A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

items.title: 100 Days of Deception
items.overview: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

items.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
items.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

items.title: Between Steps
items.overview: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

items.title: Boy, with Caution
items.overview: A disgraced teacher finds comfort in an anonymous chat partner, unaware the troubled student behind the messages is growing closer to him.

items.title: Dive into You
items.overview: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

items.title: Salon de Nabi
items.overview: We visit hair salons when we're depressed, or when we want to change how we look according to the changing seasons, or just for no reason at all. A hair salon that we can easily find in our neighborhood and that anyone can visit. "Salon de Nabi gives a warm welcome to all customers who come to visit."

items.title: The Scandal
items.overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

items.title: A Love Other Than Yours
items.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

items.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
items.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

items.title: Summertime
items.overview: After 19 years of friendship, Eun-ho is oblivious to Do-hyun’s obsessive crush. But a new student’s arrival threatens to expose the perfect façade.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.

items.listTitle: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.overview: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: Play Me
items.overview: Years after a bitter falling-out, a former child star and his estranged high school friend reunite to star in a musical, rediscovering buried love through the characters they play.

items.title: Love on the Menu
items.overview: A cheerful side dish shop owner and a chef hiding a secret cross paths at a local market, but their path to romance won't be easy.

items.title: Spooky in Love
items.overview: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

items.title: The East Palace
items.overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

items.title: Dream to You
items.overview: Two high school classmates bond over a shared love of filmmaking, turning a deep friendship into first love before an unexpected separation tears them apart. Years later, they reunite with their lives completely transformed—she’s lost her passion, while he’s become a celebrated director. Determined to reignite her dreams, he must first confront the hurt he left behind.

items.title: The Apartment Job
items.overview: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

items.title: The Husband
items.overview: Taeju and Seyun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Taeju gets Seyun kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Taeju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.

items.title: Love in Sync
items.overview: A former top actress who has lost her ability to feel and a psychological counselor who feels too much are brought together through a mysterious ability to share emotions. As she begins to rediscover emotions through him, and he learns to manage the overwhelming weight of empathy through her, the two gradually heal each other in unexpected ways.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.overview: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

items.title: The Prosecutor's Proposal
items.overview: A victim’s son and a killer’s son reunite as a prosecutor and investigator, fighting systemic corruption while becoming each other's salvation.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.overview: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

items.title: The Lie We Lived In
items.overview: While hiding a kidnapped target, a contract killer’s cover unravels when he falls for the detective hunting the truth.

items.title: Doctor on the Edge
items.overview: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

items.title: Reborn Rookie
items.overview: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

items.title: Painter of the Night
items.overview: A young artist who creates homoerotic scenes finds himself entangled in a complicated relationship with a nobleman who has an obsessive interest in both his artwork and himself.

items.title: Fifties Professionals
items.overview: Three seemingly ordinary but deadly uncles, whose fate sets them in motion again. It depicts the everyday lives of three middle-aged men, who have lived 50% of their lives, and the realistic comedy of these uncles who are even sadder because they were successful in their past.

items.title: Check In to You
items.overview: A cold-hearted executive and a romantic manager clash over a seaside guesthouse. A body-swap healing romance unfolds as a freak accident swaps their souls, forcing them to live each other's lives.

items.title: The WONDERfools
items.overview: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

items.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
items.overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

items.title: Azure Spring
items.overview: Two people stuck in their lives become haenyeo divers, finding healing and new meaning in the sea as they confront their pasts and fears together.

items.title: My Royal Nemesis
items.overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

items.title: Gold Land
items.overview: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

items.title: Filing for Love
items.overview: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

items.title: If Wishes Could Kill
items.overview: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

items.title: Sold Out on You
items.overview: A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.

items.title: The Scarecrow
items.overview: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, former high school classmates, reunite while investigating a nationwide serial murder case, pulling them into both a dangerous pursuit and an unresolved personal past.

items.title: We Are All Trying Here
items.overview: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

items.title: Reverse
items.overview: After spending 15 years consumed by revenge, a woman loses all her memories in a sudden accident, and as she searches for her past, she’s drawn toward a dangerous truth she never expected.

items.title: Absolute Value of Romance
items.overview: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

items.title: Perfect Crown
items.overview: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

items.title: Cabbage Your Life
items.overview: When executive Seong Tae-hun is abruptly reassigned to the remote village of Yeonri‑ri, his family is thrown into rural chaos. Mi-ryeo struggles with farm life, Ji-cheon begins to rethink his future, and the wary village chief keeps his distance. As homesickness grows and tensions rise, the family must decide whether to endure—or find their way back home.

items.title: Never Forget Your Enemy
items.overview: After a crash erases a decade of his memory, a man wakes up to find his former rival claiming they’re lovers and must uncover the truth behind the relationship he can’t remember.

items.title: Climax
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor rises through Korea’s elite by marrying a famous actress, only to be pulled into a ruthless power cartel where hidden informants, corporate heirs, and political players collide in a brutal struggle for survival and control.

items.title: Mad Concrete Dreams
items.overview: A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

items.title: Phantom Lawyer
items.overview: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

items.title: Still Shining
items.overview: A man and a woman whose lives are shaped by loss and time drift apart in youth and reunite a decade later, discovering that the bond they once shared remains a guiding light through love, grief, and growing up.

items.title: Boyfriend on Demand
items.overview: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings — and maybe a real shot at romance.

items.title: Always Meet Again
items.overview: After waking up as his 18-year-old self, a famous painter reunites with his first love and faces a rare chance to rewrite their story.

items.title: Siren's Kiss
items.overview: Ace insurance investigator Cha Woo-seok hunts a fraud ring tied to mysterious deaths and becomes dangerously entangled with Han Seol-ah, a flawless art auctioneer whose lovers all seem to die. As attraction and suspicion blur, he must uncover whether she’s a killer or a victim, before the truth costs him his life.

items.title: The Practical Guide to Love
items.overview: A woman determined to finally open her heart goes on a blind date with two very different men, and through the chaos and charm of it all, she ends up figuring out what love actually means for her.

items.title: In Your Radiant Season
items.overview: Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

items.title: Love Phobia
items.overview: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

items.title: The Art of Sarah
items.overview: A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?

items.title: Our Universe
items.overview: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

items.title: Bloody Flower
items.overview: A former medical school dropout claiming to be able to cure terminal illnesses is sentenced to death for the murder of 17 people. Is he a monstrous killer, or a savior holding the cure for humanity?

items.title: Laundry Romance
items.overview:
Life, like clothes, sometimes gets wrinkled and shriveled.

Jae Min, a 30-year-old job seeker who lives with anxiety that clings to him like grime, and Ji Seok, a 34-year-old voluntary unemployed person who threw away his well-ironed shirt and chose to stop.

A healing romance between two men that blends in with the noise of the washing machines running late at night at a coin laundromat.

items.title: Honour
items.overview: There's no statute of limitations on revenge. A mystery thriller about three female lawyers who confront the past head-on, as it returns as a massive scandal.

items.title: Undercover Miss Hong
items.overview: A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

items.title: Positively Yours
items.overview: A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

items.title: Love In Protocol
items.overview: Jeong Yeon joins the research lab of Yu Geon, his former private tutor, as an intern. However, Yu Geon’s attitude upon their reunion is cold.  An experiment that studies emotions, and two people facing each other once again. Subtle waves begin to ripple between Jeong Yeon and Yu Geon.

items.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
items.overview: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

items.title: No Tail to Tell
items.overview: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a soccer player — altering both of their fates.

items.title: Fan Service
items.overview: When relentless fame drives a top Hallyu idol toward collapse, a chance encounter with a college student becomes his only escape—and his greatest risk.

items.title: Spring Fever
items.overview: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

items.title: To My Beloved Thief
items.overview: Hong Eun Jo leads a double life: a servant and healer by day and a Robin-Hood-like thief named Gil Dong by night. Grand Prince Do Wol, brother to the King, begins to investigate the case. An encounter with a monk leads to them swapping souls, and they are forced to navigate each other's complex worlds.

items.title: The Judge Returns
items.overview: The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

items.title: Cashero
items.overview: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

items.title: Made in Korea
items.overview: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

items.title: Concrete Market
items.overview: Tells the story of an unbroken apartment becoming a place for barter in a world that has been ruined since the earthquake.

items.title: Idol I
items.overview: Maeng Se-na, a top star criminal lawyer who has been a fangirl for fifteen years, tries to prove her favorite idol’s innocence, who is suspected of murder.

items.title: Love Me
items.overview: An OB-GYN who seems to have it all hides the pain of running away from her family after a tragic accident, until a man who sees through her loneliness enters her life and changes everything.

items.title: Villains
items.overview: A crime drama about bloody clashes and confrontations between villains over ultra-precise counterfeit 'supernotes'

items.title: Surely Tomorrow
items.overview: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyeong-do now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

items.title: Pro Bono
items.overview: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

items.title: The Price of Confession
items.overview: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

items.title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
items.overview: Bound by a debt, an illegitimate son moves in with his aloof cousin, unaware that their uneasy deal will spiral into a deep and dangerous obsession.

items.title: Match Play
items.overview: A disciplined stuntman’s life changes when he coaches a popular idol who falls for him, forcing a choice between his quiet life and public love.

items.title: Heroes Next Door
items.overview: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

items.title: LOVE.exe
items.overview: After a university merges its modeling and computer engineering departments, the charming model Min-hak and the perfectionist coder Yeon-san, polar opposites in every way, unexpectedly fall for each other.

items.title: Dynamite Kiss
items.overview: A passionate fling in Jeju ends abruptly — until fate reunites an heir and a young woman when she joins his company, disguised as a married mother.

items.title: As You Stood By
items.overview: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

items.title: Moon River
items.overview: In Joseon, a vengeful crown prince and a memory-lost merchant mysteriously swap bodies, unraveling a web of chaos, secrets, and unexpected fate.

items.title: Dear X
items.overview: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

items.title: Peach Trap
items.overview: At the lowest point in both his career and life, Yoo Do-ha unexpectedly encounters three very different men — a cold yet caring former boss, a playful younger barista, and a devoted childhood friend. Caught in a whirlwind of overlapping “peach blossoms,” Do-ha finds himself at the center of three blossoming romances. But who will win his heart in the end?

items.title: The Manipulated
items.overview: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

items.title: Nice to Not Meet You
items.overview: A hateful romance between a professional detective actor who wants to become a melodrama master and a female reporter who was demoted from a political reporter who won the Reporter of the Year award to the entertainment department.

items.title: Last Summer
items.overview: Every summer reunion between twin brothers and their neighbor blossoms into unspoken love, until adulthood and a past tragedy change their lives forever.

items.title: Spirit Fingers
items.overview: About an ordinary high school sophomore, Song Woo-yeon, who joins a drawing club called Spirit Fingers and paints the story of finding her own color, personality, and dream.

items.listTitle: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
items.title: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
items.overview: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.

items.title: Please, Yes
items.overview: A chance, drunken kiss between two men—Su-hyeon, an emotionally guarded office worker, and Seung-hyeon, a younger student who refuses to let the moment be forgotten—unravels into an uneasy, lingering connection neither of them knows how to define. What begins as embarrassment turns into persistent encounters, forced proximity, and emotional misreadings that blur the boundary between avoidance and attraction. As Su-hyeon tries to deny what happened, Seung-hyeon challenges his restraint with quiet persistence, pushing both toward confronting feelings they never planned to name. In short-form episodic fragments, the series traces hesitation, tension, and gradual emotional recognition between two men caught between discomfort and desire.

items.title: Romantics Anonymous
items.overview: A brilliant chocolatier who's afraid of making eye contact meets an heir who can't touch others — but somehow, they're immune to each other.

items.title: Typhoon Family
items.overview: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

items.title: Would You Marry Me?
items.overview: A couple who pretend to be newlyweds, find themselves developing genuine feelings for each other as they navigate their fake marriage.

items.title: Genie, Make a Wish
items.overview: After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?

items.listTitle: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
items.title: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
items.overview: When a naïve aspiring actor meets a goblin master feared for centuries, their fated bond reignites a love powerful enough to break a thousand-year curse.

items.title: Love Reset
items.overview: After seven years together, Woojin feels his relationship with workaholic Jaehyun has reached its expiration date. When a forgotten anniversary pushes the neglected Woojin to initiate a painful breakup, Jaehyun finally realizes what he is about to lose. Desperate to win him back, Jaehyun must prove he can reset their love before it is too late.

items.title: Ms. Incognito
items.overview: A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

items.title: The Murky Stream
items.overview: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

items.title: No Mercy
items.overview: One phone call was enough to shatter one's entire world. For unknown actress So Min, everything collapses when a voice phishing scam tears her family apart. She is thrust into the darkest side of technology as her missing mother, father's death, and even the stolen voice of her late mother become weapons in a shocking scheme. With nothing left but the will to take revenge, she turns to deepfake technology as her ultimate weapon, infiltrating a vast and merciless syndicate. Along the way, she encounters Ma Seok Gu, a ruthless boss hungry for power, Jeong Hun, a cop torn between truth and loyalty, and Do Jin, a hacker with a sinister smile. Plunging into a web of betrayal and danger with the fake identities she forges, will she exact vengeance, or will they destroy her?

items.title: First Lady
items.overview: Just two months before the president-elect is sworn in, he demands a divorce from his wife – but she dreamed of becoming the first lady.

items.title: Walking on Thin Ice
items.overview: Eun-soo is a housewife, who struggles to pay for her husband's medical expenses. He is terminally ill. Eun-soo becomes entangled in a bag of drugs with a teacher named Yi-kyeong. He is a mysterious figure. Eun-soo and Yi-kyeong are chased by veteran detective Tae-gu.

items.title: To the Moon
items.overview: Three colleagues at a confectionery company struggle to break free from financial hardship. When they turn to cryptocurrency as a possible solution, their lives are shaken by risk, reward, and unexpected change. Alongside a successful but unfulfilled big data director, they face risk, ambition, and the search for meaning in an uncertain world.

items.title: My Secret Vampire
items.overview: A naïve student rents a cheap mansion in Seoul, only to learn his generous roommates are vampires—and his blood is the price of admission.

items.title: Shin's Project
items.overview: A comic drama that tells the story of CEO Shin, who mediates disputes for people who are on the edge of a cliff with a 0% chance of winning.

items.title: A Hundred Memories
items.overview: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama-comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

items.title: You and Everything Else
items.overview: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart — until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

items.title: Tempest
items.overview: Seo Munju, a highly accomplished diplomat and former ambassador to the United Nations, and Sanho, an international special agent shrouded in a veil of secrets, race to uncover the truth behind an attack that threatens the future stability of the Korean peninsula.

items.title: Confidence Queen
items.overview: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

items.title: Queen Mantis
items.overview: Cha Su-yeol, a police officer who has long despised his mother, the notorious 'Mantis' serial killer, must reluctantly turn to her for help when a copycat killer emerges.

items.title: My Youth
items.overview: The story of Sun Woo-hae and Sung Je-yun, who reunite after 15 years, struggling and living fiercely in their respective stages.

items.title: My Bias is Showing?!
items.overview: A flustered teacher scrambles to hide his fanboy side when his idol films at school—but being cast as his co-mentor makes secrets hard to keep.

items.title: Twelve
items.overview: A group of heroes, each embodying one of the 12 zodiac signs, battles to defend the Korean Peninsula from malevolent spirits.

items.title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
items.overview: After time traveling to the Joseon era, a talented chef meets a tyrant king. Her modern dishes captivate his palate, but royal challenges await her.

items.title: Aema
items.overview: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

items.title: My Troublesome Star
items.overview: A romantic comedy that follows the story of a top actress who, after reaching the peak of her career and even winning the youngest-ever Best Actress award, suffers an accident and finds herself transported 25 years into the future.

items.title: Our Golden Days
items.overview: An interior designer has a one-sided crush on her former college senior – but his best friend is secretly in love with her.

items.title: Love, Take Two
items.overview: A single mom and her medical student daughter have entered an unexpected second act in their lives. A story of love that is not an end but a beginning that comes to them as they decide to live happily today instead of tomorrow.

items.title: My Lovely Journey
items.overview: An unsuccessful idol pivots to working as a travel reporter, finding true happiness for herself and building connections with others.

items.title: Beyond the Bar
items.overview: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

items.title: Mary Kills People
items.overview: A black comedy about a doctor who illegally helps terminally ill patients with euthanasia and a detective who tracks down her illegal activities.

items.title: Trigger
items.overview: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.

items.title: The Winning Try
items.overview: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

items.title: My Girlfriend Is the Man!
items.overview: A university student falls for his first blind date, but when she mysteriously wakes up as a man, they decide to stay together and wait for her to return to her true form, testing the limits of their love.

items.title: The Defects
items.overview: An action thriller depicting the revenge of children who barely survived the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

items.title: The Nice Guy
items.overview: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

items.title: Low Life
items.overview: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

items.title: S Line
items.overview: A young woman with the ability to see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers her secret gift is no longer unique when special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market.

items.title: Law and the City
items.overview: Story of a lawyer who is known for his good appearance and straightforward personality and is working with Gyeongmin Law Firm for 9 years.

items.title: Head Over Heels
items.overview: A teenage shaman determined to change fate sets out to save a mysterious boy destined to die. As danger looms, their fated encounter sparks a powerful first love that defies darkness and reclaims hope.

items.title: I Am a Running Mate
items.overview: The story of model student Se-hoon, who goes to the student council elections as a running mate to renew his image, and gradually becomes the core of the election.

items.title: Salon De Holmes
items.overview: Four overlooked housewives, weighed down by daily chores and ignored by those around them, find renewed purpose by solving everyday cases—reclaiming their voices and reigniting long-forgotten dreams.

items.title: Hunter with a Scalpel
items.overview: A prominent female forensic investigator suffers from antisocial personality disorder and the process in which the shadow of the father she killed threatens her honor and life.

items.title: Our Movie
items.overview: A director with no future and an actress with no tomorrow fall into a love story that cannot wait.

items.listTitle: The First Night with the Duke
items.title: The First Night with the Duke
items.overview: Reincarnated as a minor character in a novel, Cha Seon-taek unexpectedly spends a night with Prince Kyungsung, sparking an intense and unexpected romance.

items.title: Mercy for None
items.overview: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

items.title: Ball Boy Tactics
items.overview: A quiet ex-gymnast and a playful basketball star fall into a slow-burning romance where every glance and touch speaks louder than words.

items.title: Good Boy
items.overview: Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.

items.title: Oh My Ghost Clients
items.overview: No Mu-jin is a labor attorney who happens to see ghosts. After coming back from the brink of death, he begins solving labor problems requested by ghosts.

items.title: ONE: High School Heroes
items.overview: A former model student, pushed by domestic abuse and bullying, joins a group that stands up to school violence and defends its victims.

items.title: Our Unwritten Seoul
items.overview: Twin sisters, whose similarities end with their looks, swap identities amid personal struggles — embarking on a journey to rediscover love and life.

items.title: Nine Puzzles
items.overview: Ten years after discovering her murdered uncle, Ena and Detective Hansaem must cooperate to stop a series of similar murders - each linked by strange puzzle pieces.

items.title: Dear Hongrang
items.overview: When a long-missing heir returns with lost memories, love and suspicion entwine. Is he truly Hongrang, or a stranger disturbing hearts and family ties?

items.title: Shark: The Storm
items.overview: An action noir about the life of Cha Woo-sol, who was born again after meeting martial arts champion Jeong Do-hyeon in a juvenile prison.

items.title: Second Shot At Love
items.overview: A woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness meets a man who believes alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic.

items.title: Tastefully Yours
items.overview: Driven to claim top culinary honors, an arrogant heir meets a low-profile but stubborn chef whose recipes astonish him — sparking an unlikely romance.

items.title: Sweetheart Service
items.overview: A fake dating contract between a determined job seeker and a marriage-weary developer takes an unexpected turn as real feelings begin to grow.

items.title: Spring of Youth
items.overview: A K-pop star, Sa-gye, reluctantly enters college, forms a 4-member mixed band, and navigates love and growth through music amid the chaos of campus life.

items.title: Pump Up the Healthy Love
items.overview: Do Hyeon-joong, a health-obsessed gym manager, helps his members transform their lives while balancing the struggles of self-employment, and forms a passionate connection with Lee Mi-ran, a travel agency manager who loves food.

items.title: Never Fair
items.overview: To get a job in Seoul, Jin Woo-hyuk ended up living at the house of his mom’s friend’s son, On Yu, a successful writer. And that’s how it all began...

items.title: Heavenly Ever After
items.overview: After life's ups and downs, a loving couple separated by death reunites in heaven — only to discover he's in his thirties while she's in her eighties.

items.title: The Haunted Palace
items.overview: In a world of folklore and mysticism, a vengeful spirit and a devoted shaman cross paths, sparking a journey of love and redemption

items.title: Something's Not Right
items.overview: Bawoo asks his longtime friend Hoon to date for a week to move on—but with a stalker looming and feelings deepening, fake love may turn real.

items.title: Resident Playbook
items.overview: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

items.title: Crushology 101
items.overview: Bunny is a talented sculpture student with a warm personality but struggles with low self-esteem due to a failed first love.

items.title: Karma
items.overview: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections.

items.title: Way Back Love
items.overview: After losing all hope to live, Jeong Hee-wan unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Kim Ram-woo, who is now a grim reaper, opening a new chapter in her life.

items.title: Business as Usual
items.overview: Min-jun, feeling stuck in his 9-to-5 job, is shocked when his ex, Jin-hwan, returns as a new colleague. As Min-jun struggles with his past, Jin-hwan has other ideas.

items.title: The Divorce Insurance
items.overview: No Ki-jun, an employee at an insurance company, decides to develop a divorce insurance policy after personally experiencing three divorces that impacted his life and finances. Despite potential biases, he believes divorce is an unforeseen disaster and establishes a team for divorce insurance.

items.title: Heesu in Class 2
items.overview: Hee-su hides his love for his best friend—until that friend falls for someone else, and silence starts to hurt.

items.title: Heo's Diner
items.overview: The story follows a character from the Joseon Dynasty who travel 400 years into the future to the modern era and unwittingly open a restaurant, leading to a series of comedic and chaotic events.

items.title: Hyper Knife
items.overview: Seok, an eager yet genius neurosurgeon is reunited with Deokhee, the professor who ruined her life long ago. Once, the two surgeons cared for each other more than anyone else. But now with nothing but hatred toward each other, Seok is furious that he is back in her life and vows to take revenge.

items.title: The Art of Negotiation
items.overview: A story following an M&A expert who is known as a legendary negotiator and his team including Lawyer O Sun Yeong and Choi Jin Sun. The M&A expert specializes in large corporation deals.

items.title: Close to You
items.overview: This is an anthology series with four love stories from eight men. Each story has its own unique outcome.

items.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
items.overview: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

items.title: The Potato Lab
items.overview: A potato researcher with 12 years of experience who is working on a secret project and a newly appointed eccentric director go head to head before falling for each other in a sweet office romance.

items.title: Secret Relationships
items.overview: Trapped in an escalating love square, a salaryman must navigate his tumultuous feelings for a colleague, a former tutor, and an heir.

items.title: Sexual Lessons
items.overview: After being dumped by his girlfriend who called their night together awful, Seongho jokingly decides to take private lessons to improve his physical intimacy skills—only to find out that his tutor is a man. As the lessons progress, what started as a simple lesson slowly turns into something much more intimate between the two.

items.title: Undercover High School
items.overview: Ace NIS agent Jung Hae-seong is demoted after a mission failure. He goes undercover at a high school to locate King Gojong's missing gold, meeting his teacher Oh Soo-ah, who sees him as her lost first love, stirring old heartbreak.

items.title: Buried Hearts
items.overview: Seo Dong-ju, who hacked a political slush fund worth two trillion won, risks it all for revenge.

items.title: My Dearest Nemesis
items.overview: Baek Su-jeong leads a planning team at a renowned department store. She meets her new boss, Ban Ju-yeon, her first love from an online game 16 years ago, stirring up memories of when he confessed his feelings but she rejected him.

items.title: The Witch
items.overview: The story of a woman who is kicked out of her village and called a "witch" when the men that she likes get hurt or die, and a man who risks his life to try to save her from the law of death.

items.title: Melo Movie
items.overview: A movie buff falls for an aspiring director, igniting a romance that fizzles out too soon. When their paths cross again, can love find its way back?

items.title: Friendly Rivalry
items.overview: A high-teen mystery thriller about a close relationship between teenage girls in a harsher survival competition than entrance examinations.

items.title: Newtopia
items.overview: Jae-yoon, a late military enlistee, and his girlfriend, Young-joo, break up over the phone over growing misunderstandings. But a zombie outbreak rocks the world. A national emergency is declared, a plane crashes in the city center, and Jae-yoon and his unit get trapped on top of a Seoul skyscraper. Young-joo risks the zombie-filled streets to find him. Can their love survive the apocalypse?

items.title: Heart Stain
items.overview: Woo-hyun was planning on hiding his crush on his homeroom teacher, but his best friend Do-ha finds out and confesses for him.

items.title: The Scandal of Chunhwa
items.overview: After failing in love, Princess Hwari vows to find her own husband, drawing the capital's top playboy and the perfect marriage prospect into a romantic entanglement.

items.title: Kick Kick Kick Kick
items.overview: Actor Ji Jin-hee and former star PD Jo Young-sik work together to launch a content company that aims for 3 million subscribers.

items.title: For Eagle Brothers
items.overview: After her husband's sudden death just ten days into their marriage, the eldest sister-in-law must step up as the head of the family, navigating the complex relationships with her five unique brothers-in-law.

items.title: Checkered Shirt
items.overview: Hangyeol sold a checkered shirt to Jungwoo, who later discovered a photo of the seller with his ex-lover? How will this ignite something more?

items.listTitle: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call
items.title: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call
items.overview: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives — bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.

items.title: Study Group
items.overview: A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.

items.title: FC Soldout
items.overview: A struggling soccer team is bought by an agency that replaces its players with attractive actors from their roster to boost profits.

items.title: Unmasked
items.overview: In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

items.title: Motel California
items.overview: A woman with a unique upbringing in a motel in the countryside leaves her hometown at 20 to pursue her career in Seoul. Twelve years later though, she returns home to heal her heart and experiences twists and turns as she reunites with her first love, a now eligible bachelor and veterinarian.

items.title: The Queen Who Crowns
items.overview: A woman from a prestigious family helps her husband become king, but their relationship deteriorates as he takes many concubines. Tensions rise as the king seeks to control her and her family.

items.title: When the Stars Gossip
items.overview: From two different worlds and with separate missions, an astronaut and a space tourist entangle in space — only to start falling for each other.

items.title: Love Scout
items.overview: Yoo Eun-ho, a single dad armed with perfection, becomes the secretary of Kang Ji-yun, the CEO of a popular headhunter company, who doesn't do anything except work.

items.title: Namib
items.overview: Former producer Kang Soo-hyun and discarded trainee Yoo Jin-woo join forces, each pursuing their dreams amid challenges and new opportunities.

items.title: Check in Hanyang
items.overview: Four trainee servants from incredibly different backgrounds try to earn their keep at the grandest inn in the Joseon Dynasty!
